title: The unix library: files, directories and descriptor safety
body: The `unix` library exposes operating-system calls: `Unix.stat` returns a file's size and kind, `Unix.opendir` and `Unix.readdir` list a directory, and `Unix.openfile`, `Unix.read` and `Unix.write` work on raw file descriptors. Failures raise `Unix.Unix_error (code, function, argument)`, where the code is a constructor such as `ENOENT` for a missing file, so a caller can match on the reason instead of parsing a message.

A file descriptor is a scarce resource. Each process has a limit, often only a few hundred on a desktop system, and a descriptor that is opened and never closed stays open until the program ends. A function that forgets to close on an error path may pass every normal test and then fail in production with `Too many open files`. The fix is the pattern from the exceptions lesson: acquire, then `Fun.protect ~finally:(fun () -> Unix.close fd)`.

`Unix.read` may return fewer bytes than requested and `Unix.write` may write fewer than given, so copy loops must handle partial transfers, and end-of-file is a zero-byte read. Test for leaks directly by counting the open descriptors (`/dev/fd` on macOS and Linux) before and after many calls, both on success and on failure: a leak then fails the test immediately, without waiting to hit the system limit.
challenge: Implement `file_size`, `list_dir` (sorted, without `.` and `..`) and `copy_file` in src/fileops.ml with the `Unix` module. `copy_file` must close both descriptors even when copying fails, and must handle partial reads and writes. The test counts the open descriptors in /dev/fd before and after hundreds of failing and successful calls, so any leak is detected whatever the system limit is.
projectInstructions: Run `dune test --root .`. Edit only src/fileops.ml. A missing file must raise `Unix.Unix_error (Unix.ENOENT, _, _)`.
question: Why is `Fun.protect ~finally` used around opening and copying a file?
correct: It closes the descriptor on every path, including errors, so repeated failures cannot exhaust the process's descriptor limit
reasoning: The finalizer runs whether the body returns or raises, so cleanup does not depend on the happy path.

projectChecks.name: a leaked source descriptor is caught on the error path
